title: eriophorum cyperinum f. brachypodum
intro: Eriophorum cyperinum f. brachypodum, commonly known as Cotton-grass, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the family Cyperaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from coughs and colds, as well as acting as an expectorant to help clear mucus from the respiratory tract, thereby alleviating congestion. The therapeutic actions of Cotton-grass include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its overall health benefits. The bioactive constituents of Eriophorum cyperinum f. brachypodum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
